profile.headline: Principle software engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications industry. Strong information technology professional skilled in Linux, Firmware, Wireless Technologies, Systems Engineering, and Testing.

positions.title: Sr Embedded Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Firmware of Point of sale device with smart card interface, capacitance signature capture, keypad, database public keys storage  and crytography encode/decode.

positions.title: Lead Engineer Software
positions.description:
ISSM for General Dynamics AIS. Designed and Developed Automatic Central Control for audit log and Anti-Virus definition update for classified system.
Designed, Developed, and Integrated customized wireless low power embedded system.
Developed inter-processor communication protocol to external devices. 
Developed Real-time overlay objects GUI development.
Developed, managed source code configuration and installation procedures for Windows and Linux.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Benchmark and optimized performance for Sun Enterprise system.
Developed Real-time Sonar Display.
Developed under ultra low power processor to control GPS, and other devices.   
Developed and integrated voice recognition software for Sonar R&D project.

positions.title: Engineering II
positions.description:
Provided technical analysis for the Surveillance Towed Array Sensor System (SURTASS).
Developed Real-time database and overlay objects.
Designed, Developed, Code, and Test real-time update data GUI for Display Processor.

positions.title: Computer Science Engineer
positions.description:
Computer Science/Math
Developed unit test code for embedded communication switch.  
Managed PVCS development system. 
Developed GUI for Real-time Data and Voice Control System for Air Traffic Control System.
